correctness.rationale: Independent exhaustive combinatorial reconstruction: a minimal winning antichain is proper iff it is pairwise intersecting. A winning singleton in a proper game gives a dictator; equal-size minimal winners give identical normalized vectors. For four players the remaining mixed-size cases have edges and triples. For one edge AB only ACD and BCD are available, and one or both give divergence (12+6 labeled choices). Two adjacent edges AB,AC admit exactly BCD, giving 12 more. A three-edge star admits its leaf triple, but both indices put the center strictly first and tie the leaves. A triangle cannot admit a triple; no larger intersecting edge set exists. The labeled proper census is 4 dictator + 1 grand-only + 15 triple-only + 26 edge-only (6+12+4+4) + 34 mixed (18+12+4) = 80, with respectively 1,1,4,4,4 orbit classes. For one through three players the totals are 1,3,11 and there are no proper mixed-size antichains. For three players without properness the only mixed-size antichains are the three labelings of {A,BC}. Direct substitution yields all reported vectors and quotas: for each weighted representative all listed minimal winners reach quota and every coalition not containing any of them is below quota. This check is analytic; the frozen verifier was inspected, not run.
